channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Cook charged with possessing live pangolin at Semporna resort
item.description: TAWAU: A cook was charged in the Sessions Court here today with possessing a live pangolin, a fully protected wildlife species, at a resort near Semporna last month.

item.title: Govt factors geopolitical uncertainty into upcoming gas roadmap
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The National Gas Roadmap, scheduled for release in the third quarter of this year, will factor in increasingly challenging geopolitical conditions, including the ongoing US-Iran conflict.

item.title: Actress, husband wanted over RM1.5mil land grant scam
item.description: SEREMBAN: Police here have received a report from a 56-year-old man claiming losses of RM1.5 million after allegedly being deceived by an actress and her husband.

item.title: Asian Games outing crucial for paddlers, says coach
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: National table tennis team head coach Beh Lee Wei believes it is imperative that her squad competes at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Sept 19-Oct 4.

item.title: 'Pearly-Thinaah must master winning on their off days'
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Women’s doubles coach Rosman Razak has challenged Pearly Tan-M. Thinaah to master the art of winning on their “off days” to find consistency at the All England.

item.title: Bukit Aman denies claim of minor detained under Sosma
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bukit Aman Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has denied claims that minors were being held under the Security Offences (Special Measures) Act (Sosma).

item.title: Speaker: Hamzah remains opposition leader
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Dewan Rakyat Speaker Tan Sri Johari Abdul has confirmed that Datuk Seri Hamzah Zainudin remains the opposition leader, as no official notification has been received from Perikatan Nasional (PN) regarding a replacement.

item.title: 90pct of bus tickets to east coast already sold ahead of Aidilfitri
item.description: SEREMBAN: Nearly 90 per cent of express bus tickets from Seremban to major east coast destinations have already been sold over the past two days, ahead of Aidilfitri.

item.title: South Africa, India eye T20 World Cup rematch as semi-finals begin
item.description: MUMBAI: Unbeaten South Africa continue their quest for a maiden World Cup title in the first semi-final of the T20 World Cup against New Zealand in Kolkata on Wednesday, with a potential repeat of the 2024 final against India awaiting.
